mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods with three consecutive monthly FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.0% for two consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger corporate profit warnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances with two consecutive UNRATE > 4.0% months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction, reducing corporate revenue expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods with two consecutive declines in both HOUST and RSAFS, or Rank IC falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During post-crisis recovery phases, industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 105.0 for two consecutive months signals strengthening manufacturing output, boosting corporate earnings and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of post-crisis recovery periods with INDPRO > 105.0 for two months, or Rank IC remains below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases corporate borrowing costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances with two consecutive FEDFUNDS > 4.5% months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the past three months indicates improving labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate profits, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods with three consecutive PAYEMS increases, or Rank IC falls below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, real sales (RSAFS) declining below 680,000 million dollars for two consecutive months signals an impending consumer spending slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of late-cycle expansion periods with two consecutive RSAFS < 680,000 million dollar months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and real GDP (GDPC1) indicate broad economic contraction in supply chains, reducing corporate output and earnings, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods with two consecutive declines in both INDPRO and GDPC1, or Rank IC falls below 0.05.
